blocks.text: I’ve always believed that a friendship breakup is more heartbreaking than a romantic breakup, especially if it is a separation that is brought by outside or natural forces both parties cannot control. The Japanese coming-of-age drama film “Look Back” explores this platonic grief. Directed by Hirokazu Kore-eda, the 2026 live-action film is based on the 2021 one-shot manga of the same name by Tatsuki Fujimoto. It follows Fujino (Natsuki Deguchi), a confident young girl who enjoys drawing manga, and Kyomoto (Aju Makita), a reclusive classmate whose artistic talent initially makes Fujino question her own abilities.
